# apple_background_asset_version (Resource)

Uploads a version of an Apple-hosted asset pack: its archive, made with `ba-package`, and optionally its manifest, which App Store Connect checks first. App Store Connect numbers the versions. When it has processed a version, the version is ready for internal TestFlight testing and supersedes the previous one there; submit it for review to release it more widely. Changed files are uploaded as a new version, which replaces the resource. App Store Connect can't delete a version, so destroying the resource leaves it. Import it by ID; the next apply then uploads the configured files if they differ.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_background_asset_version" "tutorial" {
  background_asset_id = apple_background_asset.tutorial.id
  file                = "${path.module}/assets/Tutorial.aar"
  manifest_file       = "${path.module}/assets/Manifest.json"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `background_asset_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack, e.g. `apple_background_asset.example.id`.
- `file` (String) Path of the asset pack archive, e.g. a `.aar` file. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.

### Optional

- `manifest_file` (String) Path of the asset pack's manifest, to check before the archive is uploaded. Relative paths are relative to where Terraform runs, so use `"${path.module}/..."`.

### Read-Only

- `app_store_state` (String) State of the version on the App Store, e.g. `READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION`, once submitted.
- `checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the archive.
- `external_beta_state` (String) State of the version for external testing, e.g. `READY_FOR_TESTING`, once submitted.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack version.
- `internal_beta_state` (String) State of the version for internal testing, e.g. `READY_FOR_TESTING` or `SUPERSEDED`.
- `manifest_checksum` (String) MD5 checksum of the manifest.
- `state` (String) Processing state: `AWAITING_UPLOAD`, `PROCESSING`, `FAILED` or `COMPLETE`.
- `version` (String) Version number App Store Connect assigned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_background_asset_version.tutorial
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the asset pack version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_background_asset_version.tutorial 1234567890
```
